validation.aggregateScope: Node + Chromium 157 + Firefox 160; two macOS-only gates skipped, kernel flag forensics partial on Linux. Registry gained the separate Linux display startup gate after this aggregate started.

realMainStartup.scope: Actual main.js, isolated userData, preload, revision conflict, cursor, row visibility, normal quit

statusPayload.scope: real status methods and trusted IPC handler, synthetic sanitized profiles; JSON size only, no desktop or browser

metadata.note: Synthetic profiles; real SQLite and encryption; elapsed includes 50ms persistence coalescing. No desktop rendering is measured.

observedIntermittency.observation: One aggregate run lost a CDP socket after its baseline phase; root cause not established.
observedIntermittency.followup: Focused rerun and three further isolated runs passed; later serial full aggregate also passed. No automatic retry or weakened fingerprint checks added. Harness now captures fail-closed reason, child exit and bounded stderr; failed-suite output retains the error header.

limitations: Windows/macOS desktop CI configured but not executed from this Linux workspace.
Custom macOS vendor kernels and native window controls require corresponding operating systems.
Recovery requires the same profile root, readable encryption key and writable stores; failures retain journal and guards.
